// === PAGE ===
#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  fill: rgb("#F8F7F0"),
  margin: (top: 0.9in, bottom: 0.5in, left: 1in, right: 1in),
  footer: context {
    set text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#666"), style: "italic")
    let updated = datetime.today().display(
      "Updated [month repr:long] [day padding:none], [year]"
    )
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
      align(left)[#updated],
      align(center)[Page #counter(page).display() of #counter(page).final().last()],
      align(right)[#link("https://pingfanhu.com")[pingfanhu.com]],
    )
  },
)

#set block(spacing: 0pt)

// === LISTS & TABLES ===
#show list: set block(spacing: 0.4em)

#show enum: set block(spacing: 0.4em)

#show list: it => { it; v(gap) }

#section[Research Interests]

- *Open-source Survey Platform*: Development of `surveydown`, an open-source, feature-packed R package for programmable and reproducible surveys, combining a Quarto UI, a Shiny web framework, and a PostgreSQL backend.
- *Companion Survey Tool*: Development of `sdstudio`, a companion R package of `surveydown` to provide a user-friendly interface as Shiny application for designing surveys and managing databases.
- *Electric Vehicle Smart Charging Adoption*: Survey fielding and modeling on electric vehicle owners' preferences and sensitivities of smart charging programs, including supplier-managed charging and vehicle-to-grid.
- *Grid Peak-Shaving Cost Efficiency*: Deterministic simulation of residential BEV charging load on CAISO and NYISO grid baselines, quantifying peak reduction potential and program cost efficiency across TOU configurations, adoption levels, and enrollment scenarios.

#section[Honors & Awards]

- #link("https://ospo.gwu.edu/2024-student-open-source-award-winners")[2024]: 2nd Prize in GW's 2024 Student Open Source Awards for the `surveydown` R package.
